content.value_statement: AI answers often cite competitors instead of your content. This skill helps structure pages, authority signals, and crawl access for better AI visibility.
actual_capabilities: Audits AI visibility across key queries, platforms, and competitor citations.
Checks whether robots.txt guidance allows AI crawlers such as GPTBot, PerplexityBot, ClaudeBot, and Bingbot.
Recommends extractable content blocks for definitions, comparisons, FAQs, statistics, and how-to answers.
Maps schema types to content formats that AI systems can understand.
Suggests monitoring workflows for AI Overview presence, citation rate, share of voice, and sentiment.
limitations: Does not perform live searches unless the host assistant has web access and permission.
Does not guarantee citations because AI platforms choose sources independently.
Does not implement structured data; it refers implementation work to schema-focused tooling.
Depends on accurate user-provided pages, queries, competitors, and business context.

use_cases.title: Audit AI Search Visibility
use_cases.description: Find missing AI citations, crawler blockers, and content patterns across priority queries before planning optimization work.

use_cases.title: Improve Existing Articles
use_cases.description: Rewrite articles with direct answer blocks, sourced statistics, FAQ sections, and clearer headings for answer extraction.

use_cases.title: Compete in Buyer Queries
use_cases.description: Prioritize comparison, product, and third-party presence work when competitors appear in AI answers first.

prompt_templates.title: Audit My AI Visibility
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner audit for priority search queries.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my brand for AI search visibility. My top queries are: [queries]. Check likely citation gaps, competitor patterns, and next actions.

prompt_templates.title: Optimize a Priority Page
prompt_templates.scenario: Improve one page for answer extraction.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this page for AI search extraction: [page text or URL]. Recommend answer blocks, schema types, citations, and freshness improvements.

prompt_templates.title: Find Competitor Citation Gaps
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare our AI visibility against these competitors: [competitors]. Use these queries: [queries]. Identify content gaps, third-party opportunities, and monitoring metrics.

prompt_templates.title: Build an AI SEO Roadmap
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced planning across content, schema, and monitoring.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a 90-day AI SEO roadmap for [brand]. Include page priorities, schema needs, citation sources, crawler checks, owners, and success metrics.

output_examples.input: Audit our help article for Claude and Perplexity citations.
output: Add a direct definition in the first paragraph.
Create a short FAQ section with natural-language questions.
Add dated statistics with original sources.
Confirm ClaudeBot and PerplexityBot are not blocked.

output_examples.input: Improve our comparison page for AI answer inclusion.
output: Lead with a neutral summary of both products.
Cite current pricing and feature sources.
Add update dates and author credentials.

output_examples.input: Plan AI visibility monitoring for twenty buyer queries.
output: Track whether AI answers appear for each query.
Record cited domains, pages, and sentiment.
Compare your citation rate against named competitors.
Review changes monthly and prioritize pages with missed citations.

best_practices: Start with the user queries that already trigger AI answers.
Use sourced statistics, dated updates, and clear author attribution.
Make each answer block understandable without surrounding page context.
anti_patterns: Do not keyword-stuff pages to force AI visibility.
Do not gate the only authoritative version of important content.
Do not block useful AI crawlers without understanding the citation tradeoff.

faq.question: What is AI SEO?
faq.answer: AI SEO improves how content is discovered, extracted, and cited by AI search systems and answer engines.

faq.question: Which platforms does this skill cover?
faq.answer: It covers Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, Gemini, Copilot, and related AI search workflows.

faq.question: Can this skill guarantee AI citations?
faq.answer: No. It improves the signals that can support citations, but each AI platform chooses sources independently.

faq.question: Does it replace traditional SEO?
faq.answer: No. Traditional SEO remains a foundation. This skill adds structure, authority, crawlability, and monitoring for AI answers.

faq.question: Does it create schema markup?
faq.answer: It recommends schema types for content. Dedicated schema implementation should use a structured data workflow or related skill.

faq.question: What inputs make the analysis stronger?
faq.answer: Provide priority queries, target pages, competitors, current AI citation checks, robots.txt details, and business goals.
